messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: [PD-9876] inference-latency-high — prod-us-west. Trigger: p50 latency > 200ms for /v1/generate. Link: https://pd.example/alerts/PD-9876

sam: oncall here, acking. I'll start with proxies + serving runtime.

incident-bot: sam acknowledged the page (ack at 8123456795).

maria: seeing sustained tail on router-03 ~30s, cpu spike ~92% on dedicated-proxy pool. pulling logs now.

sam: running `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep router-03` — pods near CPU limit, some restarts. logs show repeated KV-prefill requests from a batch job.

tayla: heads-up from support: 2 customer reports (acme-corp) about slow responses starting ~03:12. no 500s reported yet.

sam: no platform edge 5xxs, but dedicated pool returned 503s and routing fallback engaged for a subset of traffic. likely degraded latency for routed requests.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved (no further triggers) at 8123456860.

maria: spike subsided after autoscaler added 3 pods; appears to be transient KV-prefill storm when a scheduled job hit the cluster. marking auto-resolved but will watch 30m. :eyes:

sam: handoff: switching follow-up to #eng-runtime for postmortem. maria will watch for 1h, i'll file follow-up action. tagging tomorrow's oncall.

tayla: reached out to acme-corp — they saw slow responses but did not open a formal incident. passing note to account team.

sam: quick action items: 1) reduce prefill burst rate on batch job 2) add prefill-rate-limit to autoscaler 3) file suppression tuning for synthetic canary to cut noise. filing INF-2345.

maria: created runbook note: `prefill-rate-limit=200` as a mitigation and added a reminder to test scale behavior. will open PR for autoscaler config change.

incident-bot: Thread closed by incident-bot (final state: auto-resolved).
